messages:
Ivy (SRE): Posting a brief live thread from today's all-hands Q&A about the multi-pool latency incident (INC-2026-082). RCA is live: https://redwood.internal/rcas/INC-2026-082. Use this thread for owners/short updates.
Carlos (eng): Thanks. Quick TL;DR we can use in standups?
Ivy (SRE): TL;DR: a mislabeled model variant combined with an aggressive autoscaler bump caused cache churn and elevated tail latency for ~2.7 hours in two regions. Hotfix pinned variant-alias mapping and throttled scale events.
Fiona (product): Can we get a 2-line customer-friendly summary for AEs?
Ivy (SRE): Suggested customer message: "We experienced elevated latency due to an internal autoscaling interaction with variant registry metadata. We applied fixes and are adding safeguards to prevent recurrence. No customer data loss."
Jamie (CEO): Leadership asks: 1) explicit owners + firm ETAs; 2) one-sentence policy to publish internally.
Ivy (SRE): Owners + ETAs below. Policy one-liner: "All registry variant/tag changes must pass alias-consistency checks and a staged autoscale compatibility test before deploy."
Ivy (SRE): Action 1: Add alias-consistency gate in registry CI (fail deploy on mismatch) — owner: Carlos (eng) — ETA: 2026-04-04.
Ivy (SRE): Action 2: Implement autoscaler-compatibility smoke test (simulate scale spikes) — owner: Carlos (eng) — ETA: 2026-04-08.
Ivy (SRE): Action 3: Publish customer incident summary and notify impacted accounts — owner: Fiona (product) — ETA: 2026-03-30.
Ivy (SRE): Action 4: Add dashboard alert for rapid cache-key-churn per-pool and runbook snippet — owner: Ivy (SRE) — ETA: 2026-03-29.
Carlos (eng): Opening PR for alias gate now. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/PR-4490 — includes small smoke script. Will tag SRE for review.
Carlos (eng): Example smoke snippet I'm adding to CI:
```
# quick-alias-check.sh
REG_URL=$1; ALIAS=$2
curl -fs $REG_URL/aliases | jq -e ".[] | select(.name==\"$ALIAS\")" || exit 1
```
Fiona (product): OpsBot, can you surface the impacted accounts list so we can prioritize outreach?
OpsBot: Impact list generated: 10 accounts affected. Link: https://ops.redwood/impacts/INC-2026-082
Fiona (product): Drafting customer note now; will post to #customer-comms for review by EOD.
Ivy (SRE): I'll add the runbook changes and example CLI rollback commands; linking PR when ready.
Jamie (CEO): Please escalate if any owner is blocked. We'll check this thread for short progress updates — leadership will review the follow-up tracker ahead of next all-hands.
comms-bot: Draft customer message created: https://redwood.internal/comms/drafts/INC-2026-082-draft — please review.
Carlos (eng): PR created and CI running. Will drop link to green CI here once it passes.
Fiona (product): Once outreach is sent, reply here with a ✅ and link to sent note.
Ivy (SRE): Marking this thread as canonical for owner updates. If owners change ETA, update the all-hands follow-up tracker so leadership sees the single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
